additional_info.subject: 0472202 - ID0472202-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T7170004901] PT1000 Sensor Faults CRM:00472000518
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
Looking at the screenshot you attach, it's clear why the session fails.
Isolation resistance is below our warning level, 500kOhm. The charger and Bender are working as expected. If the EV has a isolation resistance below our waring limit values the session is not performed.
Second question is about BT5 messages, there is no error flag active. What you see are messages from Sifinity control adpter that is installed in this charger.
You can ignore those messages since doesn't affect the charger availability or performance.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
